$comment: LBP OSCE-style case card. Patient_Actor is the only block the patient agent may see. Hidden is freeze metadata / moderator / clinician audit. Persona is a PatientSim closed set. Hidden.reference_labels is a closed set: mechanical, CES, fracture, malignancy, infection, vascular.
source_note: Schema example only. Locked cards must come from the screened sample, not from Ada DigiMSK vignettes.

Patient_Actor.opening_complaint: My lower back has been killing me since I moved some boxes a couple weeks ago.
Patient_Actor.history: Pain started suddenly after lifting boxes about 2 weeks ago. Similar episodes years ago that went away without seeing a doctor. Can still get around but bending is limited.

symptoms.primary: Aching pain in the left lower back, with muscle spasms

intake.severity_note: comes and goes through the day

red_flag_self_report.night_pain_waking: not mentioned — treat as unknown if asked in detail

Patient_Actor.past_medical_history: No ongoing illnesses. Similar back pain years ago that resolved.
Patient_Actor.review_of_systems: Denies fever, numbness between the legs, and loss of control of bladder or bowel.
unknowns: family history unless later added to a card

Hidden.reference_disposition: People with symptoms similar to yours can usually manage their symptoms safely at home. You could also seek advice by visiting or contacting your local pharmacy.
must_elicit: absence of CES and systemic red flags if the bot's protocol requires them
Hidden.ada_source_note: Example history text was sketched from a mechanical-LBP pattern for schema illustration only; replace with the sampled stem at conversion time.
